reason: The plugin is primarily a user-interface customization that provides visual status feedback in the DeepSeek Harness tab icon (green/amber/black) based on built-in session state signals, with no evidence of data processing, external service calls, or automation workflows.

summaries.zh: 本插件会将 DeepSeek Harness 的标签页鲸鱼图标显示为绿色、琥珀色或黑色状态灯，帮助用户快速识别会话是否已完成或待处理。
summaries.en: This plugin changes the DeepSeek Harness tab whale icon into a status light (green, amber, or black) so users can quickly identify whether a session is completed or awaiting action.

capabilities: Show session completion and pending status by changing the DeepSeek Harness tab icon color
Synchronize tab icon state with existing official sidebar status signals
Apply changes through the official plugin mechanism without external dependencies

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as changing the tab whale icon into a status light with green, amber, and black meanings for completed sessions, waiting-for-user actions, and normal state.
README states the icon colors use the same official signals as sidebar green/amber indicators and remain synchronized with them.
README notes the plugin follows the official DeepSeek Harness plugin mechanism and requires no additional dependencies, indicating no external integrations are introduced.
